fields.description: Stored checksum byte at buffer start: FUN_082530e8 computes ~sum over the packed image and copies it to the buffer head with FUN_08262e68; FUN_082531d4 re-sums and compares via FUN_08262e1c. Exact covered range is a RAM-domain detail, so no checksum spec is claimed.
fields.evidence: FUN_082530e8 computes local_14=~sum(bytes) and FUN_08262e68-copies it to buffer start; FUN_082531d4 re-sums and FUN_08262e1c-memcmps the head byte.
fields.name: stored_checksum

fields.description: 32-bit save identifier word, little-endian 0x42545545 (bytes read big-endian spell BTUE). First bit-packed field of the save image.
fields.evidence: FUN_08031508 writes DAT_0803154c as first 0x20 bits via FUN_08253024; FUN_080313c4 reads 0x20 bits via FUN_082532c4 and requires equality with DAT_08031400.
fields.name: save_identifier

fields.description: Save format tag; writers store constant 12 (0x0c) and the loader rejects any image whose tag differs.
fields.evidence: FUN_08031508 and FUN_08031560 write constant 0xc in 8 bits via FUN_08253024; FUN_080313c4 reads 8 bits via FUN_082532c4 and requires value 0x0c.
fields.name: save_format_version

fields.description: Lead byte: top two bits are the two 1-bit header flags (load mirror DAT_0803142c[0..1]); low six bits are the first six packed state bits (r3a[0..2], r3b[0..2]) in MSB-first pack order.
fields.evidence: FUN_080313c4 reads 2x1 bits via FUN_082532c4 into DAT_0803142c; FUN_08031508 writes DAT_08031550 2x1 bits via FUN_08253024; FUN_0803111c/FUN_08031270 pack r3a then r3b immediately after (DAT_0803123c, DAT_08031240).
fields.name: save_head_flags

fields.description: Packed 1-bit state slots, MSB-first pack order: r3c,r3d,r4,r12,r20,r10,r19a[0..11]. Load mirror arrays at DAT_08031244..DAT_0803125c via FUN_0803111c; stored via FUN_08031270; zeroed by FUN_08031430.
fields.name: packed_state_a

fields.description: Packed 1-bit state slots continued: r19a[12..18],r19b,r16,r6 plus tail bits tail78,tail79[0..2],tail7a (load mirror DAT_0803126c+0x78..0x7a). Same pack/unpack/init call chain as packed_state_a.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803111c unpacks 19,19,16,6,1,3,1 trailing groups via FUN_082532c4 (DAT_0803125c tail, DAT_08031260, DAT_08031264, DAT_08031268, DAT_0803126c+0x78/0x79/0x7a); FUN_08031270 repacks via FUN_08253024; FUN_08031430 zeroes these ranges.
fields.name: packed_state_b

magic_signatures.description: 32-bit save identifier; big-endian byte order spells BTUE (game code). First packed field written by FUN_08031508, verified by FUN_080313c4.
